title: Codex Skill Registration and Edit Guide
desc: How Codex should create, edit, verify, install, and re-read AppBot skills.
steps: Use wkappbot skill contribute or wkappbot skill edit for skill changes; never edit .skill.json directly.
Keep each step short and explicit; use pipe-separated --steps and avoid semicolon-heavy text that can collapse into one visible step.
After any create or edit, run wkappbot skill install --app <app> --force or wkappbot skill sync, then re-read the skill.
Use --add-step for incremental changes and verify the catalog output with wkappbot skill read.
Treat wkappbot skill read as the source of truth; do not trust edit exit code alone.

requirements.cmd: wkappbot skill edit codex-skill-registration-edit-guide --add-step one step
requirements.expect: adds one step without collapsing the others
confirms the final catalog output after install or sync
